verdict.rationale: Swell documents a public Backend API with basic-auth secret keys split into test and live environments, official Node and PHP libraries, and per-resource reference pages for products, stock and purchase links. It also offers a runtime schema-introspection call covering every model, which suits agent-driven use. Probes found no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, which is a gap for machine consumption but does not contradict that the API exists. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
